name: High Minus Low
description: Value factor representing the return of high book-to-market equities minus low book-to-market equities.
positive_direction: A positive factor return means the high book-to-market side outperformed the low book-to-market side.

name: Robust Minus Weak
description: Profitability factor representing the return of firms with robust operating profitability minus firms with weak operating profitability.
positive_direction: A positive factor return means the robust profitability side outperformed the weak profitability side.

name: Momentum
description: Momentum factor representing the return of recent outperformers minus recent underperformers.
positive_direction: A positive factor return means recent winners outperformed recent losers.
